utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Is that actually happening, or just another one of those plans?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's definitely happening! I saw the flyer myself—they're fixing bikes, small appliances, even sewing machines.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive? I heard we're fixing up old electronics this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, this weekend? I thought it was next month.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, I'm pretty sure it's this weekend. I heard it from Maria.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive? When is it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's next Saturday, but you might want to check with the coordinator.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, I'll check with them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it's been acting up lately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I've noticed the parts stock is running low. We might need to prioritize what gets fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe we should check the inventory together, see what's most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the repair drive? I can help coordinate times that work around school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's perfect, Faye! I can check with the other neighbors about their availability and we can find a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, keep me posted once you hear back and I'll slot it in around the school runs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Oren. I heard there's talk about a neighborhood repair drive. Do you know what the plan is?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but, uh, I can't quite recall the details. Did we decide on a date?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don't recall us settling on a date yet. We need to get that sorted before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive? We're getting everyone together to fix up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds like a great idea, but do we have enough tools and supplies for everyone? I worry we'll be scrambling mid-project.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, I've already asked a few folks to bring spare tools, and we've got a small budget for supplies. Should be plenty!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that the repair drive everyone's been talking about? I've heard bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's right! We're collecting broken items and pooling our skills to fix them up next Saturday. Would you like to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! What kind of things are people bringing to fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Repair drive? I want to make sure I understand exactly what you need—could you explain a bit more about the issue?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: My old toaster has been acting up; it won't stay down when you push the lever. I thought maybe someone with a bit of know-how could take a look during the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So the lever won't latch down? Do you remember the brand or model? That might help us figure out the fix.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for organizing this. I've been struggling with some repairs around the house.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Uli. Happy to help out. What repairs are you tackling?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The roof's been leaking pretty bad after the storm. I've been putting it off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a truck full of tools if you need any!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of tools do you have? I could use some specifics.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, a drill set, and even a welding kit if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Bo! Have you seen the repair drive parked over on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, can't say I have. Been rushing around all morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's the white van with the orange stripe. I can point it out if you want to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I can lend out if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's really kind of you, Gus. What kind of tools do you have?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a solid set of wrenches, a couple of hammers, and a power drill that could come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have a timeline for the repair drive? I need to plan my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything official.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, I thought I saw a notice pinned up at the community center. Maybe I was mistaken?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help rounding up volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That'd be great, Jules! I could definitely use a hand signing people up at the community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing! I'll grab a buddy and we can tag-team the sign-up table. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, are we still on track for the repair drive this weekend? I've been tallying the supplies we have so far.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey, Cleo! Yeah, sorry I'm late to the planning—what's the tally looking like?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We've got a good amount of lumber and nails, but we're short on roofing material. Do you know anyone who might have some to spare?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm thinking of bringing in my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds great! But I have to check if it conflicts with the kids' soccer games on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the soccer games! Well, they might have Sunday slots too if Saturday doesn't work for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What's that about again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a neighborhood event where we fix broken items together—think of it as a communal repair shop. We'll have tools and volunteers to help with mending clothes, electronics, furniture, and more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds cool, but I'm swamped. Maybe next time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you were working on that repair drive. Need any help with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, could use a hand. Meet at my garage in 10?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll be there in 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell! Did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? We could really use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A repair drive? I haven't heard about it yet—tell me more!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a community event at the park where folks bring broken items and volunteers fix them for free. Think you can help me round up more people?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, are you heading to the repair drive? I was thinking of going too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'm on my way. Do you know what time it starts exactly?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it starts at 2 PM, but let me double-check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what's broken that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check—are we talking about the same repair drive? I need a bit more context to know what exactly is broken.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, the repair drive for the community center—I heard some tools and equipment are busted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard there's a repair drive happening. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I signed up for something, but I can't quite remember what I was supposed to fix. Maybe you could remind me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's for fixing up the community garden shed—the roof's been leaking. Does that ring a bell?
